baseline: H-09 (issue #56) curated base failure rates for the H-Phase 1 BOM baseline (hw/bom/bom.json PRT-001, PRT-002). Rates are SN 29500 base-failure-rate classes as tabulated in a public secondary source (TI SLYP685); the primary SN 29500-2/-4 table lookup with the temperature and voltage stress factors, and vendor FMEDA data for the selected MCU, replace these entries at H-02 vendor selection. Every entry is traceable to a schema-validated extract; no rate is a silent number (HwAGENTS.md rule 2). Requirements: HW-NF-004, HW-SF-005.

standards.title: Siemens SN 29500 'Failure rates of components' (SN 29500-2 integrated circuits; SN 29500-4 passive components: capacitors) - base failure rates at reference conditions
standards.citation: Class values as tabulated by Texas Instruments, SLYP685 slide 'Example of FS FIT rates acc. to SN29500' (hw/bom/datasheets/extract-ti-slyp685-fmeda-example.json); the licensed SN 29500 parts themselves are not retained

standards.title: IEC TR 62380:2004 Reliability data handbook - Universal model for reliability prediction of electronics components, PCBs and equipment (withdrawn 2015; successor IEC 61709)
standards.citation: Declared for completeness: no entry of this database is curated from IEC TR 62380 yet; it is the fallback source for component classes SN 29500 does not tabulate (recorded so the issue #56 'standards used' statement is exact)

standards.title: Manufacturer AEC-Q100/Q200 qualification reports and FIT/FMEDA data for the selected parts
standards.citation: Declared for completeness: no vendor FIT data exists before H-02 vendor selection; when it does, it supersedes the SN 29500 class value of the affected entry (confidence vendor-data)

entries.table_or_section: SN 29500-2 integrated circuits, microcontroller class as tabulated in SLYP685 ('MCUs 150 FIT'); primary table row pending
entries.reference_conditions: Base failure rate at the standard's reference conditions; temperature/voltage stress factors not applied; SRAM soft-error rate not included (SLYP685 note: base failure rates)
entries.note: Superseded at H-02 by the STMicroelectronics STM32G4 functional-safety FIT/FMEDA data for the selected part number (vendor-data), which also supplies the failure-mode distribution replacing the FMEDA assumptions.

entries.component_class: Capacitor (SN 29500 class 'Resistors, Capacitors, Diodes'), upper class value
entries.table_or_section: SN 29500-4 passive components, capacitors, as tabulated in SLYP685 ('Resistors, Capacitors, Diodes 1-2 FIT'); upper value taken; primary table row pending
entries.reference_conditions: Base failure rate at the standard's reference conditions; voltage-stress and temperature factors not applied (the WCCA operating point 0.54 of rated voltage at 85 degC is below the SN 29500 reference stress for a Grade 1 part)
